# dsh-code-review

> Review, stage and commit the uncommitted Git changes of the repository that
> belongs to the current DSH conversation — with non-modal floating review
> windows, side-by-side diffs, file and hunk operations, commit/push (including
> in-panel remote setup), optional AI-assisted grouping, and an explicit
> AI commit-message draft that reuses the repository's own commit style.

A plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH) Web UI. It opens a non-modal floating review window per conversation, not a
full Git client.

## Install

```text
DSH plugin manager → install_bundle → path to this package directory
```

Published on npm as `@acanzaima/dsh-code-review` (0.2.0+): the package name can
be used as the bundle target instead of a local directory.

The package has no runtime dependencies and ships a prebuilt `client.js`; no
build step is required to install it.
